messages:
Jordan (Content): kicking this off — mini workshop + benchmark narrative for the new refapp. goal: 1) snackable tutorial (10–12 min) 2) short benchmark blog + figshare data 3) 30m webinar to convert dev signups :rocket:
Sam (DevRel): love it. timeline?
Jordan (Content): target launch next Thurs EOD. webinar the following Tues evening. 1 week prep for assets + routing.
Elaine (Growth): inbound routing: we should send registrants to a gated preview repo + hubspot form with utm_source=mini-workshop. Sam, can you confirm required fields?
Sam (DevRel): yup. need name, email, company, use-case checkbox, and a quick checkbox for "interested in dedicated/private" so sales gets flagged. will share form snippet.
Sam (DevRel): ```html
<form action="https://hubspot.example.com/submit">
  <input name="email" required />
  <input name="firstname" />
  <input name="company" />
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_source" value="mini_workshop" />
</form>
```
Ana (Designer): assets — I can get a hero image + 2 social cards by Wed. need the exact tagline.
Jordan (Content): draft tagline: "Build faster with Redwood — mini workshop + micro-benchmarks." open to brevity.
Mike (Engineering): for the benchmark narrative, I can run a quick throughput/latency comparison between the default quantized model and our tuned profile. will attach a reproducible script and raw numbers. prefer to surface p95 latency and tokens/sec for 256/1024 contexts.
Marisol (Ops): can we make a small runbook for webinar infra? who is the host and where do recordings land?
Jordan (Content): host = Sam, co-host = Elaine. Recording -> internal S3 bucket + public YT. Marisol please add retention/permissions to the runbook.
Elaine (Growth): CTA copy options for the page — pick one and we’ll A/B test in the email: 1) "Register for the live mini workshop" 2) "See the mini workshop + sample benchmarks" 3) "Try the refapp and compare latency"
Sam (DevRel): prefer 1 for the event page, 2 for follow-up email.
Ana (Designer): quick note: social cards need clear metric callouts. Mike, please give a one-line stat we can call out (e.g., "2.3x tokens/sec") by Tue noon.
Mike (Engineering): working on it — initial run shows ~2.1x tokens/sec at 256, ~1.8x at 1024 vs baseline. will validate and share numbers + command: ```bash
python run_bench.py --model tuned --seq-len 256 --runs 50
```
Jordan (Content): I'll draft the announcement post and webinar description tonight and post for review tomorrow. want a short benchmark writeup + link to notebook in the blog.
Elaine (Growth): tagging funnel: registrants -> HubSpot list "mini-workshop-2024" -> auto email with repo link + cheat sheet. Sales notify if "interested in dedicated/private" checked. Sam, can you wire the webhook?
Sam (DevRel): will wire hubspot webhook and test with DeployBot. DeployBot: trigger webhook test?
DeployBot: webhook test started for form id=mini_workshop_form. status: queued.
DeployBot: webhook test complete. delivered=12, errors=0.
Sam (DevRel): looks good. I'll add a small serverless lambda to transform payload into hubspot + slack alert to #sales-leads with the tag.
Marisol (Ops): I'll add a check in runbook to make sure recordings are published and that we rotate credentials for the public S3 link.
Jordan (Content): copy iteration plan — phase 1 (announcement copy + social), phase 2 (webinar landing + benchmark blog), phase 3 (follow-up assets + repo). please leave comments directly on the google doc I just shared. link: https://docs.google.com/mini-workshop-draft
Elaine (Growth): I'll prepare the promo schedule; drop windows for social + email. prefer 2 emails (announce + reminder).
Sam (DevRel): action items: 1) hubspot form + webhook (me) 2) demo + recording plan (me + Mike) 3) benchmark script + numbers (Mike) 4) design assets (Ana) 5) promo schedule + tracking (Elaine) 6) runbook + infra (Marisol) 7) copy + blog draft (Jordan).
Jordan (Content): solid — can everyone drop a quick ✅ when done with their item so we can track in the doc?
Ana (Designer): ✅ will upload cards by Wed.
Mike (Engineering): ✅ bench initial pass, will update numbers tomorrow.
Sam (DevRel): ✅ hubspot form up on staging, webhook tested.
Elaine (Growth): ✅ draft promo calendar in the sheet.
Marisol (Ops): ✅ runbook scaffold created; will fill infra steps.
Jordan (Content): thanks team — shout if anything blocks. low-friction: prioritize the benchmark stat and hubspot wiring first so we can start ads and social tracking. :sparkles:
